title: Too many checkout fields | UTD Shopify Themes
description:
Every extra checkout field is a tiny reason to quit — name, company, address line two, phone. They add up fast. Ask for the minimum, let express pay do the rest. Fewer fields, more finished orders. Ultra keeps checkout tight.
👉 Ultra on the official Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/ultra
